title: Kollura Sri Mookambika
desc: Kaumasura, a demon, persistently troubles Kola Maharishi during his meditation. When Kola Maharishi prays to Goddess Parvati for deliverance, she incarnates as Mookambika to vanquish the demon.

title: Sampathige Saval
desc: Siddappa, a cruel landlord, refuses to pay the funeral expenses of his servant after his accidental death. Angered by the betrayal, the worker's son, Veerabhadra, grows up to resent Siddappa.

title: Paramashiva
desc: Three brothers, Shiva, Raghu and Shankar, dote on their sister, Swati, and strive for her happiness. Problems arise when Swati gets married to a cunning, rich man who has ulterior motives.

title: Police Story - 2
desc: Newly promoted DCP Agni faces off against a ruthless crime matriarch. When her retaliation claims his family and partner, Agni embarks on a relentless quest for justice.

title: Cobra
desc: A genius mathematician uses his skills to assassinate his targets and stay clear of law enforcement. However, a vigilante secretly tracks his movements, vying for revenge.
